### Bamberg Baskets Fall to Bonn in 71:85 Thriller

*Played Saturday, 14 November 2026* *(updated with new sources)*

The BMA365 Bamberg Baskets suffered a 71:85 defeat to the Telekom Baskets Bonn in their 9th league game of the season. The game, played on November 14, 2026, saw Bonn secure their first away win of the season, with six players scoring in double figures. For Bamberg, Trevon Scott led the scoring with 14 points, while Jordan Jones, Richard Balint, and Hason Ward each contributed 10 points. Bonn's Marcus Foster topped the scoring with 13 points, with Patrick Heckmann and Grayson Murphy also scoring 11 points each. The game was a closely contested affair, with Bamberg taking an early lead before Bonn's strong finish in the fourth quarter sealed the win. The loss drops Bamberg to 11th place in the league table, while Bonn extends their winning streak to three games.

### Skyliners Suffer Fourth Consecutive Loss to Gladiators

*Played Sunday, 15 November 2026* *(updated with new sources)*

The Skyliners Frankfurt suffered their fourth consecutive loss in the easyCredit BBL, falling 85:99 to the VET-CONCEPT Gladiators Trier on November 15. The game was played in front of a sold-out crowd at the Süwag Energie ARENA. The Gladiators, who were led by Justin Simon's 23 points, took control of the game in the second half, outscoring the Skyliners 45:32 in the third quarter. The Skyliners' Judah Mintz led the team with 16 points, but it was not enough to overcome the Gladiators' strong defense. The loss marks the Skyliners' fourth consecutive defeat, while the Gladiators secured a crucial win to move forward in the league.

### Niners Chemnitz crush Basketball Löwen Braunschweig 111:79

*Played Sunday, 15 November 2026* *(updated with new sources)*

NINERS Chemnitz secured a crucial win in their battle to avoid relegation in the easyCredit Basketball Bundesliga, defeating Basketball Löwen Braunschweig 111:79. The win was the team's highest of the season, with 30 assists and 17 three-pointers made. Jannis von Seckendorff and Elias Rödl set new career highs with 19 and 12 points respectively, while Phlan Fleming had a double-double with 12 points and 14 assists. The win was a much-needed reaction to the team's previous losses, and they will look to continue their momentum in their next game against Tofas Bursa. The Löwen, meanwhile, struggled with their shooting, hitting only 34% of their field goals, and were unable to contain the NINERS' offense, which shot 58% from the field and 56.7% from three-point range.

## European Cups

### Rostock Seawolves face top EuroCup team Hapoel Jerusalem

The Rostock Seawolves will host top EuroCup team Hapoel Jerusalem at the StadtHalle Rostock on Tuesday evening. The Israeli team has been undefeated in the EuroCup, winning six of their seven games with a two-digit margin. The Seawolves, however, lost their first game against Hapoel Jerusalem in Belgrade with a score of 73-94. The Israeli team has strengthened their roster with experienced players such as Shake Milton, Jaleen Smith, Lorenzo Brown, and Kenny Lofton Jr. Hapoel Jerusalem's key players include Kenny Lofton Jr. (19.0 points per game), Devontae Cacok (10.3 points per game), and Jaleen Smith (11.1 points per game). The Seawolves' head coach Przemyslaw Frasunkiewicz acknowledges that Hapoel Jerusalem is a strong opponent, but is optimistic about his team's chances. The game will be broadcast live by MagentaSport at 19:50 UTC, and tickets are available online or at the box office.

Sources:

- [Rostock Seawolves: Als Underdog gegen Topfavorit Hapoel Jerusalem](https://www.seawolves.de/als-underdog-gegen-topfavorit-hapoel-jerusalem)

### Bayern face Kaunas in EuroLeague, Ulm, Bonn, and Würzburg in key games

The German professional basketball league has several key games scheduled for this week. In the EuroLeague, FC Bayern Munich will face Zalgiris Kaunas on Tuesday, with Bayern's Rokas Jokubaitis returning to his home country after recovering from a knee injury. However, it is unclear if Maodo Lo will play for Kaunas against Bayern, as he has been out of the EuroLeague rotation in recent weeks. In the EuroCup, ratiopharm Ulm will face Balkan Botevgrad on Tuesday, with a win necessary to stay in playoff contention. Bonn and Würzburg also have key games in the Champions League and FIBA Europe Cup, respectively.

## Around the League

### Rostock Seawolves Invite Members to 2026 Annual General Meeting

The Rostock Seawolves basketball team has invited its members and their guardians to the 2026 Annual General Meeting, scheduled for November 30, 2026, at 6:00 PM at the OSPA Am Vögenteich in Rostock. The meeting will cover various topics, including the approval of the 2025/2026 financial year's accounts, the election of a new auditor, and the presentation of the 2026/2027 budget. Members are encouraged to submit their proposals for the meeting by November 23, 2026. The meeting's agenda and supporting documents, including the minutes of the 2025 Annual General Meeting, are available for download on the team's website.

Sources:

- [Rostock Seawolves: Einladung zur Mitgliederversammlung 2026 (Geschäftsjahr 2025/2026)](https://www.seawolves.de/einladung-zur-mitgliederversammlung-2026-geschaeftsjahr-2025-2026)

### Mushidi Nominated for Germany's World Cup Qualifiers

Kostja Mushidi, a 28-year-old power guard, has been nominated by German national team coach Alex Mumbru for the upcoming World Cup qualifiers. Mushidi will represent Syntainics MBC in the 16-man squad for the two games against Latvia on November 27 in Riga and Poland on November 30 in Frankfurt. Germany leads Qualification Group K with 15 points, ahead of Croatia and Poland, who are tied with 15 points. Latvia is in third place with 12 points, followed by the Netherlands and Israel with 10 points each. A win in either game would secure Germany's spot in the World Cup in Qatar. Mushidi has played in all eight of Germany's games this year, and has a total of 10 appearances in the national team. Both games will be broadcast live on Magenta Sport and Magenta TV.

Sources:

- [Syntainics MBC: Kostja Mushidi erneut für Deutschland nominiert](https://syntainics-mbc.de/kostja-mushidi-erneut-fuer-deutschland-nominiert)

### Alba Berlin Youth Teams and LOK Bernau Post Mixed Results

Alba Berlin's youth teams had a mixed weekend in various competitions. In the WNBL, the Albatrosse women's team won 94-30 at home against the Mitteldeutsche Basketball Academy. Meanwhile, the Alba Berlin women's team in the WU16 Girls Champions Cup in Hungary finished second, losing 52-87 to Segle XXI in the final. In the NBBL and JBBL, Alba Berlin's teams lost 70-68 to Rostock Seawolves and 70-69 to Friedenauer TSC, respectively. LOK Bernau, Alba Berlin's cooperation partner, had a successful weekend, winning 85-65 and 94-54 against SG Braunschweig and BSW Sixers, respectively, in the ProB league.

### Bamberg Baskets edge out Falcons in DBBL-Pokal thriller

The Medikamente per Klick Bamberg Baskets edged out the Falcons Bad Homburg 53-51 in a closely contested DBBL-Pokal match. The game was played in front of a crowd of around 400 in the Bamberger Graf-Stauffenberg-Halle, with the Baskets coming out on top despite a strong performance from the Falcons. Bamberg's Jackie Grisdale was the top scorer with 17 points, while Chiara Dröll of the Falcons had 14. The Baskets will now move on to the Achtelfinale, with the draw for the next round set to take place soon. Bamberg's Elise Tweedie and Grisdale were praised for their efforts, but the team's 50 turnovers and 6 assists were notable weaknesses in the game.

Sources:

- [Bamberg Baskets: Medikamente per Klick Bamberg Baskets stehen im DBBL-Pokal Achtelfinale! | Bamberg Baskets](https://www.bamberg.basketball/news/medikamente-per-klick-bamberg-baskets-stehen-im-dbbl-pokal-achtelfinale)

### Bamberg Baskets Face German Champions Keltern in DBBL-Pokal Achtelfinale

The Bamberg Baskets will face the reigning German champions, Keltern, in the DBBL-Pokal Achtelfinale. The match was determined by a draw, with Marlies Askamp, a 190-time German national team player and 2002 WNBA champion with the Los Angeles Sparks, selecting Keltern as the next opponent for the Bambergerinnen. Keltern is currently leading the 1. Bundesliga table without a single loss, having defeated ALBA BERLIN 70-42 in their previous match. The DBBL-Pokal Achtelfinale games will take place on December 5-6, with the exact schedules to be announced soon. The Bamberg Baskets' ticket pre-sale for their match against Keltern begins on Friday at 10:00 AM.
